'''Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline''' is a natural gas pipeline with segments that are operating and cancelled.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2sC090G Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline,] Wikipedia, accessed January 2018</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from the Rocky Mountains to Wyoming, Kansas, Oklahoma, Texas, Nebraska, Missouri, and Kentucky.

==Background==

=== Main Line ===
The pipeline is operated by Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc., which is jointly owned by Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec (CDPQ) and by GE Energy Financial Services.
<ref>[http://www.oilfieldwiki.com/wiki/Southern_Star_Central_Gas_Pipeline,_Inc Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc], Oilfield Wiki, accessed January 2018</ref>
===Midwest Market Access Project===
The expansion project involves modifications and upgrades to the existing Grabham compressor station in Kansas, USA. Developers have already applied for approval with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC).<ref name="eia">[https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php Natural Gas Data, Pipeline Projects] Energy Information Agency, accessed August 11, 2023</ref>

According to the U.S. Energy Information Administration, as of April 2021 the project had received FERC approval and is expected to begin service in 2023.<ref name="eia" /> As of 2023 however, no evident progress had been made since project announcement, and the expansion is now considered cancelled. 

=== Cedar Vale Compressor Station Project ===
The expansion project involves building a compressor station in Osage County, Oklahoma, that is to be operational by 2026.<ref name="eia" />
